question: I'm a CS junior who has completed 15-122 (grade: B) but have not yet taken 15-150. Can I register for 15-210 (Parallel and Sequential Data Structures and Algorithms)?
expected_answer: No — 15-210 requires BOTH (15-150 at least C) AND (15-122 at least C). P-004 has 15-122 with a B, but the 15-150 requirement is an additional hard prerequisite, not an alternative. Without 15-150, registration is blocked.
common_mistake: Treating the two prerequisites as OR alternatives instead of AND requirements; assuming 15-122 alone is sufficient since it's listed first
needs_verification: Confirm 15-210 prerequisite is strictly (15-150 C) AND (15-122 C), not OR
Confirm P-004 has not completed 15-150 in a semester not yet recorded
Confirm P-004's grade in 15-122 meets the C threshold
